Name: Eye-Hair-Skin Color Wheel
Author: Cielestia
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Adds a color wheel to both NEW character screen, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense Mirror[/url]
When you are in the mirror UI, Click K for the wheel to pop up.


Added in GMCM a key bind changer
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url]  — Required[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]  — For the mirror part[/color]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]  — optional, but needed to change the shortcut through the in-game config menu.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][/url]

Manifest.Name: Hair Color Wheel
Manifest.Description: Color Wheel with Hair, Eyes, and Skin modes; editable RGB/hex; Android touch support; safe New Character hosting; smooth native drag input; GMCM; Fashion Sense/custom hair support.
